architecture_controls.expectation: Domain models and workflow decisions are separated from API transport.
External-facing behavior is represented through local ports and mock adapters.
Write actions use commands and read actions use queries.
Business transitions emit local domain events that are persisted through audit evidence.
Persistence is behind a repository with an explicit local unit-of-work boundary.
Application errors use typed codes and structured API responses.
Bank, PSP, ODR, NPCI/RBI, and payment rail activity remains mocked or simulated.

review_readiness.boundary_review: Explicit local-only and mocked/simulated constraints are present in policy, prompt, runtime, and workflow notice.
review_readiness.maintainability_review: Application logic is decomposed into domain, API, repository, runtime, adapter, command/query, event, and error modules.
review_readiness.test_review: Phase validator and tests check evidence files, architectural markers, and governance boundaries.
